payload.title: the integrator's line cut competes with bind's
payload.body: At f4227d81 the runtime cuts plan/<plan> at plan bind, in a worktree at <main worktree>.plan-<plan>. The deliver skill (packages/canon/src/skills/deliver/skill.ts, line(P)) and docs/role.md still have the integrator cut the same branch at its first dispatch with git worktree add <path> -b plan/<plan> <base>, which fails once bind has cut it. Two artifacts realize the birth of a plan's line; which text is revised, and by which unit, is open.
